title: Evolutionary Ensemble Search: Council-Guided Program Evolution with Persistent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2609.17590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evolutionary Ensemble Search (EES) constructs machine-learning procedures through expert-guided program evolution. A role-specialized council turns task evidence and experimental results into structured search directions. An orchestrator allocates these directions to execution specialists and an evolutionary engine. The engine selects measured parents, diagnoses their errors, and produces descendants through code mutation, structured pipeline edits, and crossover. Each child must execute and acquire its own validation evidence. Population archives retain useful alternatives, while compatible predictions compete in a validation-gated ensemble stage. Search adapts through parent-relative operator credit, session memory, and problem-indexed lessons retrieved across runs. We specify these mechanisms, distinguish their execution profiles, and define the contracts required to compare candidates as their computations change. A public MLE-benc

translated_title: 进化集成搜索：基于委员会引导的持久记忆程序进化
translated_abstract: 进化集成搜索（EES）通过专家引导的程序进化来构建机器学习流程。一个角色专业化的委员会将任务证据和实验结果转化为结构化的搜索方向。编排器将这些方向分配给执行专家和进化引擎。进化引擎选择经过度量的父代，诊断其错误，并通过代码变异、结构化流水线编辑和交叉产生后代。每个子代都必须实际执行并获得自身的验证证据。种群档案会保留有用的备选方案，而兼容的预测则在验证门控的集成阶段相互竞争。搜索过程通过父代相对的算子信用评估、会话记忆以及跨运行检索的问题索引经验教训实现自适应。本文详细阐述了这些机制，区分了它们的执行特征，并定义了在候选方案计算方式发生变化时对其进行比较所需的契约规范。公开的MLE-benc（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出进化集成搜索（EES）框架，通过角色专业化委员会引导的程序进化、持久记忆机制（算子信用、会话记忆与跨运行经验教训）以及验证门控集成，自动构建并持续优化机器学习流程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Evolutionary Ensemble Search (EES), a framework that automatically constructs and iteratively optimizes machine-learning procedures through council-guided program evolution, persistent memory mechanisms (operator credit, session memory, and cross-run lessons), and validation-gated ensembling.
